name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
one_liner: A command-line tool that lets an AI agent open a real web browser, read what's on the page, and click/type/fill forms the way a human would, one step at a time.
buyer: A technical founder or automation agency building AI-driven workflows that need to click through websites that don't offer an API (booking portals, legacy admin panels, competitor sites).
business_use_cases: An automation agency builds a monitoring bot that logs into client vendor portals nightly to pull invoices or pricing, since those sites have no API.
A small e-commerce seller automates competitor price-checking across marketplaces that block scrapers but allow normal browsing.
A QA/testing freelancer offers AI-driven regression testing for client websites, using it to script and rerun user flows automatically.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'automate this website' as a paid service for businesses stuck with no-API legacy portals
Run it as the engine behind a hosted price/availability monitoring SaaS

steal_this: Pick one tedious manual task a local business does on a website weekly (e.g. checking a supplier portal), script it with this CLI, and sell the automation as a one-time setup.
